title: tejasprof84/RAG_ocr_project
summary: 该项目利用OCR技术从PDF和图像中提取文本，将其转换为嵌入向量，并通过向量数据库检索相关内容。使用LLM生成基于上下文的准确答案，构建了一个智能文档问答系统。该系统结合了OCR、RAG和LLM技术，适用于需要文本分析和问答功能的场景。，基于模型推理的架构
description: Built an intelligent document QA system using OCR and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Extracts text from PDFs/images, converts it into embeddings, retrieves relevant content from a vector database, and generates accurate context-based answers using an LLM.
